# GO term enrichment on the significant gene sets 

I have lists of significantly DE genes in all contrasts. This is the same as the GO enrichment for chapter3.
Detailed documentation is here: https://rdrr.io/bioc/topGO/f/inst/doc/topGO.pdf

## Install libraries

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly=TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install("topGO")
BiocManager::install("GO.db")
```

## read input files

annotation and background gene set

```{r}
make_annotation_df_from_eggnog <- function(annotation_path){
    annot_header = c("query","seed_ortholog","evalue","score","eggNOG_OGs","max_annot_lvl","COG_category","Description","Preferred_name","GOs","EC","KEGG_ko","KEGG_Pathway","KEGG_Module","KEGG_Reaction","KEGG_rclass","BRITE","KEGG_TC","CAZy","BiGG_Reaction","PFAMs")
    annotation <- read.csv(annotation_path, sep="\t", comment.char = "#", header=FALSE, col.names = annot_header)
    background_geneIDs <- annotation$query
    # prepare for input
    valid <- !is.na(annotation$GOs) & annotation$GOs != "-"
    annotation_df <- strsplit(annotation$GOs[valid], ",")
    names(annotation_df) <- annotation$query[valid]

    return(annotation_df)
}

annotation_path="/Users/miltr339/work/c_maculatus/C_mac_eggnog_diamond.emapper.annotations_geneIDs" # created from the eggnogmapper output with /Users/miltr339/work/PhD_code/PhD_chapter4/src/make_annot_with_geneIDs.py
## Dcar annotation:
#/proj/coleoptera-genomics-2025/snic2021-6-30/Milena/chapter2/eggnog/Dcar/Dcar_eggnog_diamond.emapper.annotations

annotation_df <- make_annotation_df_from_eggnog(annotation_path)
```


## run enrichment

make GO enrichment object for each contrast
```{r}
GO_enrichment_analysis <- function(sig_infile, annotation_df, semantic_clustering=FALSE){
  # prepare input data
  sig_df <- read.csv(sig_infile, sep=",", header=TRUE)
  geneList <- factor(as.integer(sig_df$sig_DE))
  names(geneList) <- sig_df$geneID
  ## downsample annotation to only include genes in the current test
  counts <- count(geneList)
  sigs_num <- length(geneList[geneList==1])

  ## only run if there are at least 10 significantly differentially expressed genes! # nolint
  if (sigs_num > 9){
    gene2GO <- annotation_df[names(annotation_df) %in% names(geneList)]
    ## create topGO object
    # ontology = BP means that it's all biological process level GOs
    GOdata <- new("topGOdata", ontology = "BP", allGenes = geneList, annot = annFUN.gene2GO, gene2GO = gene2GO)
    # run enrichment test
    result <- runTest(GOdata, algorithm = "elim", statistic = "fisher")
    ## about the "elim" algorithm from the documentation: "Here one computes the p-value of a GO term conditioned on the neighbouring terms. The tests are therefore not independent and the multiple testing theory does not directly apply. We like to interpret the p-values returned by these methods as corrected or not affected by multiple testing."
    allRes <- GenTable(GOdata,classicFisher = result,orderBy = "classicFisher",topNodes = 1000)
    # make vector of sig. GO terms
    allRes$classicFisher <- as.numeric(gsub("< ", "", allRes$classicFisher))
    sigRes <- allRes[allRes$classicFisher < 0.05, ]
    go_ids <- sigRes$GO.ID
    # write to outfile
    outfile_name <- str_replace(sig_infile, "sig_DE_list_", "GO_enrichment_")
    outfile_name <- str_replace(sig_infile, "interaction", "interaction_GO_enrichment") 
    outfile_name <- str_replace(sig_infile, "ignore", "ignore_GO_enrichment") 
    outfile_name <- str_replace(outfile_name, ".txt", ".csv") 
    write.csv(sigRes, outfile_name, row.names=TRUE)

    ## make enrichment visualization
    # use simplifyEnrichment
    # this takes super long, so only do when it's relevant, not worth it for everything
    if(semantic_clustering){
      outfile_name <- str_replace(outfile_name, ".csv", ".png") 
      mat <- GO_similarity(go_ids, ont = "BP")  # biological process (BP) like above! needs to match
      # do the clustering, this takes quite a while
      png(outfile_name, width = 10, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
      df <- simplifyGO(mat, use_raster = FALSE)
      dev.off()
    }

    return(sigRes)
  }
}
```

analyze GO term enrichment from upsetplot intersection lists
```{r}
semantic_clistering_from_table <- function(sig_infile){
  # prepare input data
  sig_df <- read.csv(sig_infile, sep="\t", header=FALSE)
  go_ids <- sig_df$V1
  sigs_num <- length(go_ids)

  ## only run if there are at least 10 significantly differentially expressed genes! # nolint
  if (sigs_num > 9){
    outfile_name <- str_replace(sig_infile, ".txt", ".png") 

    ## make enrichment visualization
    # use simplifyEnrichment
    mat <- GO_similarity(go_ids, ont = "BP")  # biological process (BP) like above! needs to match
    # do the clustering, this takes quite a while
    png(outfile_name, width = 10, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
    df <- simplifyGO(mat, use_raster = FALSE)
    dev.off()
  }
}
```
